verdict.rationale: Folk's pricing page lists "AI Assistants" as a plan feature, which suggests a built-in assistant, but nothing documents what it does or whether users can hand it tasks. The MCP docs describe external assistants (Claude, ChatGPT) connecting to folk, and AI-powered custom fields are a separate feature, so neither counts as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: documentation of what the built-in assistant can do, evidence of delegating multi-step tasks to it inside the product, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
